params.val: automatically switches out to a valid replacement, if one is available
the holder's HP has not just crossed from above half to at or below half max HP

Showdown source hooks a dedicated EmergencyExit event, checked after every action's residual damage during the turn (and again on switch-in) — not gated to being struck by a move. Restructured from on_hit to on_turn_end so it also covers non-move HP loss (Leech Seed, poison, weather chip, etc.), matching Zen Mode's continuous-check shape. Threshold confirmed inclusive (hp <= maxhp/2, crossing from originalHP > maxhp/2). Identical mechanic to Emergency Exit.
